description: Maps source fields to target fields with type conversion and unit specification.

data.info: Data containing fields to be mapped. Can be a list of Data objects, single Data object, or JSON string.

field_mappings.info: List of field mappings defining source field, target field, type conversion, and units.

errors.no_data: No input data provided for field mapping.
errors.empty_data: Input data is empty or contains no records.
errors.invalid_json: Invalid JSON format in input data.
